HOME SCIENCE MARCH — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Heating until a solid melts

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Convenience Foods.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Careers in Food and Nutrition.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pastry Making.

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Clothing Construction Processes: Collars and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Clothing Construction Processes: Sleeves and Cuffs 3.4 Garment Design and Sketch and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Clothing Construction Processes: Sleeves and Cuffs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Garment Design and Sketching 3.5 Entrepreneurship in Clothing and Textiles Page  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Garment Design and Sketching and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship in Clothing and Textiles Page 12 of 53 1 STRAND 1.0: FOOD AND N and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
